mainEntity.name: Can I build an AI chief-of-staff workflow on a tight budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a draft-only workflow if your budget is limited. You can use a single coordinator and one specialist to produce a research summary, content outline, or campaign checklist before paying for broader automation. Track where manual effort remains and add tools only when a repeated bottleneck justifies the cost. The free starting option described by Run My AI Business can support initial learning, while the $9 monthly paid newsletter subscription provides full weekly issues; platform and integration expenses are separate considerations. Avoid paying for several assistants before confirming that one workflow produces useful work consistently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Begin with one coordinator, one specialist, and draft-only outputs. Use available free resources to test a real workflow, track remaining manual effort, and add paid tools only when a repeated bottleneck justifies them. Run My AI Business lists a free starting option; its full weekly newsletter subscription is $9 monthly.
